_comment: Hand-written Ballpark questions. gen_ballpark.py merges these with questions it computes (Cricsheet totals, sums from the Laws, date spans). Every number and claim here, facts included, must be checked against the linked page before it goes in. Sources are 'wiki:<page title>'. 'topic' (a string or a list) keeps related questions on different days and is stripped from the output. Answers must be positive.

questions.prompt: Wilfred Rhodes took more first-class wickets than anyone, playing from 1898 to 1930. How many?
questions.fact: For Yorkshire and England.

questions.prompt: How many runs did Sachin Tendulkar score in international cricket, across Tests, ODIs and T20Is?
questions.fact: In 664 international matches.

questions.prompt: How many balls did Muttiah Muralitharan bowl in ODIs?
questions.fact: He took 534 ODI wickets, the most by anyone.

questions.prompt: How many balls did Shane Warne bowl in Test cricket?
questions.fact: 708 wickets in 145 Tests.

questions.prompt: How many international matches did MS Dhoni play, across Tests, ODIs and T20Is?
questions.fact: 90 Tests, 350 ODIs and 98 T20Is.

questions.prompt: Mithali Raj retired in 2022 as the leading run-scorer in women's ODIs. How many ODI runs did she make?
questions.fact: In 232 ODIs. She retired from international cricket in June 2022.

questions.prompt: Until Mithali Raj passed her in 2021, England's Charlotte Edwards held the record for runs in women's international cricket. What was her total?
Mark Boucher holds the record for dismissals by a wicketkeeper across all international cricket. How many catches and stumpings?
questions.fact: 555 of them in Tests, also a record.

questions.prompt: How many runs did Jacques Kallis score in Tests and ODIs combined?
questions.fact: 13,289 in Tests and 11,579 in ODIs, with 292 and 273 wickets.

questions.prompt: How many international wickets did India's Jhulan Goswami take before retiring in 2022?
questions.fact: In 284 matches; 255 of them came in ODIs.

questions.prompt: How many international runs did Kumar Sangakkara score across all formats?
questions.fact: Including 63 centuries.

questions.prompt: Courtney Walsh holds the record for the most ducks in Test cricket. How many?
questions.fact: He also took 519 wickets in 132 Tests.

questions.prompt: What is the highest team total in Test cricket, made by Sri Lanka against India in Colombo in 1997?
questions.fact: 952 for 6 declared, at the R. Premadasa Stadium.

questions.prompt: The 1939 Timeless Test at Durban ran for twelve days. How many runs were scored in the match?
questions.fact: The most in any Test. It was abandoned as a draw with England 654 for 5, chasing 696, so they could catch the boat home.

questions.prompt: What is the most runs scored in a single ODI, by both teams together?
questions.fact: Australia made 434 for 4 and South Africa chased it, 438 for 9, at Johannesburg on 12 March 2006.

questions.prompt: What is the highest team total in a men's T20I, made by Zimbabwe against Gambia in 2024?
questions.fact: 344 for 4. Gambia were bowled out for 54, so the 290-run margin is a record too.

questions.prompt: What is the highest team total in first-class cricket, made by Victoria against New South Wales in 1926–27?
questions.fact: At Melbourne.

questions.prompt: Kumar Sangakkara and Mahela Jayawardene put on the highest partnership in Test cricket, against South Africa in 2006. How many runs?
questions.fact: Sangakkara made 287 and Jayawardene 374. No other first-class partnership has passed 600.

questions.prompt: What is the highest team total in women's ODIs, made by New Zealand against Ireland in Dublin in 2018?
questions.fact: 491 for 4 in 50 overs.

questions.prompt: How many Ashes series have England and Australia played, counting the first in 1882–83, up to 2026?
How many people can the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad hold?
How many spectators watched the 2023 World Cup final between India and Australia in Ahmedabad?
The 2022 IPL final, Gujarat Titans against Rajasthan Royals, drew the biggest crowd in the Narendra Modi Stadium's history. How many people?
How many spectators attended the 2023 men's ODI World Cup in India, across all 48 matches?
questions.fact: The most at any Cricket World Cup.

questions.prompt: How much prize money did Australia receive for winning the 2023 World Cup, in US dollars?
The first day of the 2025 Boxing Day Test against England set a new record crowd for cricket at the MCG. How many people?
How many people watched the 2020 Women's T20 World Cup final at the MCG, a record crowd for women's cricket?
questions.fact: Australia beat India by 85 runs, on International Women's Day.

questions.prompt: How many people can the Melbourne Cricket Ground hold, seated and standing?
questions.fact: 95,000 seats plus 5,000 standing.

questions.prompt: How many spectators can Lord's hold?
How many people can Eden Gardens in Kolkata hold?
questions.fact: The ground was established in 1864.

questions.prompt: Lord's famously slopes from one side to the other. How many centimetres does the ground drop?
questions.fact: About 8 ft 2 in, from the Grand Stand in the north down to the Tavern and Mound Stands in the south.
